title: Complete 95-Generation Synchronized Puranic Royal & Rishi Genealogies of India (F.E. Pargiter, Ancient Indian Historical Tradition, 1922)

nodes.name: Ayodhya Solar Spine Anchor (Gens 2–30: Ikshvaku to Trayyaruna)
nodes.era: Satya Yuga (Pargiter Master Table Gens 2-30, p. 145)
nodes.role: First 30 Generations of Solar Ayodhya Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 90-92, 145
nodes.notes: Anchor for the first 30 generations of Aikshvaku kings (Mandhatri, Purukutsa, Trasadasyu), unrolled father-to-son below.

nodes.name: Ayodhya Solar Spine Anchor (Gens 31–64: Trishanku to Dasharatha)
nodes.era: Treta Yuga (Pargiter Master Table Gens 31-64, pp. 145, 147)
nodes.role: Golden Era of Solar Dynasty Leading to Lord Rama Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 92-94, 145-147
nodes.notes: Anchor for Gens 31-64 (Harishchandra, Sagara, Bhagiratha, Raghu, Dasharatha), chained individually below.

nodes.name: Ayodhya Post-Rama Spine Anchor (Gens 66–95: Kusha to Brihatkshaya)
nodes.era: Dvapara Yuga (Pargiter Master Table Gens 66-95, p. 149)
nodes.role: 30 Generations from Rama's Son Kusha to Mahabharata Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 94-95, 149
nodes.notes: Anchor for post-Rama Solar kings down to Brihadbala (Kurukshetra) & Brihatkshaya, chained below.

nodes.name: Videha / Mithila Solar Dynasty (All 54 Kings: Nimi → Mithi Janaka → Siradhvaja → Janaka-Ugrasena)
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 95-96, 145-149
nodes.notes: Founded by Ikshvaku's son Nimi -> Mithi Janaka -> Siradhvaja Janaka (father of Goddess Sita).

nodes.name: Manu's Other Solar Kingdoms: Vaisali (Nabhanedishtha → Marutta → Trinabindu), Sharyatas & Nabhagas
nodes.role: Ancient Dynasties of North Bihar (Vaisali) & Gujarat (Anarta)
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 97-98, 145-147
nodes.notes: Nabhanedishtha's line produced Marutta & Trinabindu; Sharyati's line produced Raivata Kakudmin.

nodes.name: Kanyakubja Dynasty Anchor (Amavasu → Jahnu → Gadhi → Vishvamitra)
nodes.role: Aila Kingdom of Kanauj & Origin of Vishvamitra Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 99-101, 234-237
nodes.notes: Pururavas's son Amavasu -> Jahnu -> Gadhi -> Brahmarshi Vishvamitra (Rigveda Mandala III).

nodes.name: Kasi (Varanasi) Dynasty Anchor (Kshatravriddha → Dhanvantari → Divodasa II → Alarka)
nodes.era: Gens 5-94 (Pargiter Ch. IX p. 101; Ch. XIII pp. 153-155)
nodes.role: Ancient Sacred Kingdom of Varanasi & Origin of Ayurveda Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 101, 145-155
nodes.notes: Kshatravriddha -> Dhanvantari -> Divodasa II -> Pratardana -> Alarka.

nodes.name: Haihaya Dynasty Anchor (Yadu → Sahasrajit → Kartavirya Arjuna → Talajanghas)
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 102, 144-146, 153-156
nodes.notes: Kartavirya Arjuna (Gen 31) of Mahishmati; crushed by Parashurama & Sagara.

nodes.name: Yadava Main Line Anchor (Kroshtu → Shashabindu → Vidarbha → Satvata → Vrishni)
nodes.role: Complete Yadava Pedigree Anchor (Yadu to Krishna & Vajra)
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 102-107, 144-148, 284
nodes.notes: Kroshtu -> Shashabindu -> Jyamagha -> Vidarbha -> Satvata -> Andhaka & Vrishni.

nodes.name: Druhyus (Gandhara → Pracetas) & Turvasus (Pandya, Kerala & Chola Anchor)
nodes.role: Northwest (Gandhara/Central Asia) & South Indian Aila Bridges
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 108, 144, 146
nodes.notes: Druhyu -> Gandhara -> Pracetas; Turvasu -> Marutta -> Pandya, Kerala, and Chola.

nodes.name: Anavas Anchor (Ushinara → Shibi & Titikshu → Bali → Anga/Vanga/Kalinga → Karna)
nodes.role: Progenitors of Panjab (Shibi) & Eastern India (Bengal/Odisha/Anga) Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 108-109, 145-149
nodes.notes: Ushinara -> King Shibi; Titikshu -> King Bali -> Anga, Vanga, Kalinga, Pundra & Suhma -> Karna.

nodes.name: North & South Panchalas Anchor (Mudgala → Sudas → Drupada & Draupadi)
nodes.role: Rigvedic Battle of Ten Kings Hero Sudas & Panchala Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 115-117, 146-148
Rigveda VII.18
nodes.notes: Ajamidha -> Nila -> Mudgala -> Divodasa -> Sudas -> Drupada -> Draupadi & Dhrishtadyumna.

nodes.name: Cedi & Magadha Barhadratha Anchor (Vasu Uparichara → Brihadratha → Jarasandha)
nodes.role: First Historical Dynasty of Magadha & Cedi Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 118-119, 149
nodes.notes: Vasu Uparichara -> Brihadratha -> Emperor Jarasandha & Damaghosha -> Shishupala (Cedi).

nodes.name: Post-Mahabharata Kurus Anchor (Janamejaya III → Adhisimakrishna → Nicakshu → Udayana)
nodes.era: c. 950-500 BCE (Pargiter Ch. XXIV p. 285; Ch. XXVII p. 330)
nodes.role: Continuation of Pandava/Kuru Royal Line After Hastinapura Flood
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 285, 330
nodes.notes: Nicakshu moved Kuru capital to Kaushambi in Vatsa down to King Udayana.

nodes.name: Great Rishi Clans Anchor: Bhargavas & Angirasas / Kanvas
nodes.role: Complete Genealogies of Bhargava, Angirasa & Kanva Seers Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 191-202, 218-227
nodes.notes: Synchronizes Bhrigu/Cyavana/Jamadagni/Parashurama/Valmiki & Atharvan/Brihaspati/Bharadvaja/Drona across the 95-gen master table.

nodes.name: Great Rishi Clans Anchor: Vasishthas (Vyasa), Atreyas, Kashyapas & Agastyas
nodes.era: Gens 1-94 (Pargiter Ch. XVIII, XX, XXII, pp. 203-242)
nodes.role: Complete Pedigrees of Vyasa, Durvasas, Rishyashringa & Agastya Anchor
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 203-242
nodes.notes: Synchronizes Vasishtha -> Shakti -> Parashara -> Vyasa -> Shuka alongside Datta/Durvasas, Kanva, Rishyashringa & Agastya.

nodes.name: Historical Magadha Anchor (22 Barhadrathas → Pradyotas → Shishunaga/Bimbisara → 9 Nandas)
nodes.role: Bridge from Mahabharata Magadha to Buddha & Chandragupta Maurya
sources: Pargiter Ancient Indian Historical Tradition pp. 179-182, 286-287
nodes.notes: 22 Barhadrathas -> Pradyotas -> Bimbisara & Ajatashatru -> 9 Nandas -> Chandragupta Maurya (322 BCE).

nodes.name: Gupta Empire Anchor (Sri Gupta → Chandragupta I → Samudragupta → Vikramaditya → Skandagupta)
nodes.role: Classical Golden Age of India Anchor
sources: Allahabad Pillar Inscription
Vishnu Purana IV.24
nodes.notes: Gupta emperors unrolled person-by-person in Wave 5.
